# grafana_adaptive_traces_policy (Resource)

Manages a Grafana Cloud Adaptive Traces sampling policy.

Each resource manages one policy, identified by the UUID that the API assigns, and can be imported with it. Policies that the API creates itself, such as those of type `anomaly`, are never read, adopted or deleted by this resource.

Notes:

* Creating the first policy on a stack starts Adaptive Traces filtering, and deleting the last one stops it.
* Only one active `diversity` policy and one active `volumetric` policy are allowed per stack.
* A `drop` policy discards the traces that match all of its sub-policies, where an `and` policy keeps them. The API accepts one only while a policy of another type, other than `anomaly`, exists. Use `depends_on` to create it after, and destroy it before, the policies it relies on.
* Expiring policies are not supported. A policy that has an expiry cannot be imported, and an expiry set outside Terraform is cleared the next time Terraform updates the policy.

* [Official documentation](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/adaptive-telemetry/adaptive-traces/)

Required access policy scopes:

* adaptive-traces-policies:read
* adaptive-traces-policies:write

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an access policy token with the adaptive-traces-policies:read and
# adaptive-traces-policies:write scopes, set as adaptive_traces_auth.
#
# Creating the first policy on a stack starts Adaptive Traces filtering, and
# deleting the last one stops it.

resource "grafana_adaptive_traces_policy" "errors" {
  name = "Keep all traces with errors"
  type = "status_code"
  body = jsonencode({
    status_codes = ["ERROR"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The type-specific body of the policy, as a JSON object string. Use `jsonencode()` to write it. The API validates the body when the policy is created or updated, and its error message is reported when it rejects one.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy.
- `type` (String) The type of the policy. It can be changed in place. Allowed values: `always_sample`, `and`, `boolean_attribute`, `bytes_limiting`, `composite`, `diversity`, `drop`, `latency`, `numeric_attribute`, `ottl_condition`, `probabilistic`, `rate_limiting`, `span_count`, `status_code`, `string_attribute`, `trace_flags`, `trace_state`, `volumetric`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy, a UUID assigned by the API.
- `version_created_at` (String) When the current version of the policy was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `version_created_by` (String) The user that created the current version of the policy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import grafana_adaptive_traces_policy.name "{{ id }}"
```
